title: Circuit Simulator Architecture
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Circuit Simulator
description: An interactive architecture diagram of the browser-based circuit simulator. Learners click any of twenty components to see its role, ownership, connections, and requirements, and step through how one edit flows from the interface through the simulation worker and back to the screen.

learningObjectives: Explain the role of each major component of the circuit simulator
Identify which components run on the main thread and which run in web workers
Trace how a single value change flows from the interface through the engine and back to the screen
prerequisites: Basic idea of a browser main thread and web workers
Basic idea of a time-stepping circuit simulation

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Click-to-reveal exploration plus a step-through worked example
keyQuestions: Why does the simulation run in a worker rather than on the main thread?
Which component is the single source of truth for what is saved in a file?
What changes in the trace when the student rewires the circuit instead of changing a value?
commonMisconceptions: The interface calls the engine directly; in this design every change goes through document edits and worker messages
Undo rewinds simulated time; in this design undo applies to the running circuit without touching time
assessmentOpportunities: Predict the next component before each trace step
Sketch the path of a wiring change and explain how it differs
